title: IntegrationEvent
description: Common envelope for a cross-component integration event recorded by the control plane (integration/flow). Tamper-evident and hash-chained with the same algorithm as platform/audit (sha256 over canonical JSON with the hash field zeroed; prev_hash seeded at "genesis"). Each entry records one step of an end-to-end flow (e.g. campaign.complete, finding.created, evidence.collected, access.granted, action.executed).

type.description: Dotted event type, e.g. campaign.complete, finding.created, evidence.collected, access.granted, action.executed.

source.description: Component that produced the event (ai-redteam-platform, pentest-manager, ai-compliance-hub, open-pam-jit, agent-sandbox).

action.description: The API action invoked, e.g. run_campaign, add_finding, collect_evidence, approve, run.

subject.description: Primary resource id the event is about.

refs.description: Cross-references to related resources in other components (campaign_id, engagement_id, system_id, request_id, ...).

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event, or "genesis" for the first.

hash.description: sha256 (hex) over the canonical JSON of this event with this field zeroed.
